rubric.basis: Gemini 4 Carbon (High), October 28 launch. AA Intelligence Index v5.0 59 => 5; Google comparison gives AA Terminal-Bench 4.0 65.2% => 5. AA Carbon-specific profile reports 1M context => 4, 102.5 output tokens/s => 3, and text/image/speech/video input => 5. Google introductory $2 input/$10 output per million gives 3:1 blended $4/M => 3.5; later $4/$20 gives $8/M, excluded from launch price score. AA lists later standard prices. One independent benchmark analysis verified (undated AA profile); fewer than three reviews because initial access is restricted. Google announcement and current DeepMind comparison opened; no Argon specifications inherited.
